text: "We often celebrate a 'fully booked' calendar as a sign of high productivity, but a 100% utilization rate is usually just a metric of poor planning. If your day is back-to-back meetings from nine to five, when do you actually execute the strategy you just discussed in those calls? I've seen leaders brag about being busy while failing to move the needle on core projects. We need to stop measuring success by sheer activity and start measuring it by actual output."
